beats.label: 贴台疾进
beats.detail: In a sharp burst the challenger drives off his rear foot, left foot reaching forward, sword tight to ribs; red sash snaps behind, eyes narrowed.

beats.label: 送锋逼近
beats.detail: Accelerating from the planted left foot, he sends the blade toward the upper chest; the keeper calmly slides east and lifts his blade, sleeves trailing.

beats.label: 触锋慢放
beats.detail: At 2.0 seconds the blades meet; in slow motion the keeper redirects the thrust, steel glint following contact, suspended dust and taut faces readable.

beats.label: 骤快错身
beats.detail: In a sudden release of speed the thrust skims past; the challenger passes the keeper shoulder, coat whipping, surprise entering his eyes.

beats.label: 一寸停锋
beats.detail: In slow motion the keeper checks his returning blade exactly three centimetres from the side neck; challenger freezes wide-eyed, cloth still travelling, no injury.

beats.label: 垂剑认输
beats.detail: With the tip held absolutely still, the challenger slowly lowers his sword to his thigh, jaw unclenching; robe and sash settle after his body stops.

beats.label: 单一机位
beats.detail: Locked-off oblique wide shot, both bodies and path visible through the final frame; one continuous shot, no cut.

continuity.exit: Challenger screen left at (-0.15,1.3,0.15), facing screen right toward keeper, left foot just planted, right heel lifted, sword still chambered beside ribs; keeper screen right at (0,0,0.15), sword low; sash trails screen left, no blade contact.

board.prompt:
Create ONE cinematic storyboard still, 16:9, premium painterly 3D Chinese wuxia animated feature, not a photo. Reference 1 = white keeper identity and clothing ONLY; reference 2 = teal challenger identity and clothing ONLY; reference 3 = courtyard architecture, materials and dusk palette ONLY, not its camera or exact staircase count. Exactly two adult men except when specified offscreen. One plain straight jian each, empty scabbards, no extra weapon. Same grey stone low dais, muted red flags, warm western rim light. No captions, text, panel layout or montage. Oblique wide full-body two-shot from WEST, 28mm camera height 1.5m. Teal challenger screen LEFT pushes off rear right foot, left foot reaching toward screen RIGHT, blade tightly chambered along ribs pointing forward. White keeper screen RIGHT waits with sword low. Sash trails left, slight dust behind launching foot. Freeze at master time 0.5 seconds, no contact. Entire bodies visible.
CRITICAL SPATIAL CORRECTION: BOTH fighters feet ON TOP of the SAME 8m circular stone dais filling the entire foreground. White keeper at its CENTER, never outside its rim. Teal challenger moving across its north half. The dais must NOT sit behind the fighters. Camera WEST looking EAST; low ruined east wall behind, bell tower LEFT background, tree RIGHT background; NO central temple doorway or staircase, these are north offscreen left. Sword grip at challenger right RIBS with bent right elbow BEHIND him, not already fully thrust. Challenger left leg forward and right leg behind. This is the first half-second of a drive, still a 1.8m gap.
Spatial correction takes priority over the environment reference composition. Preserve illustrated cinematic quality. Draw a fresh composition from the specified side.
